daily.today_energy: Your intuition is running hot today, Pisces. Trust those gut feelings nudging you toward something new—they're basically your spiritual GPS right now. Lean into the mystery.
daily.love: Someone's been thinking about you more than you realize. Whether it's a text incoming or just good energy, reciprocate that vibe authentically. Real connections thrive on honesty.
daily.career: This is a solid day to pitch that idea you've been sitting on. Your creative energy is magnetic, and people are actually listening. Don't dim your light—let it shine.
daily.health: Your body's asking for slowness today. Consider this your sign to journal, meditate, or just exist without a to-do list. Mental peace fuels physical wellness.

weekly.overview: Mercury's dancing through your zone of deep reflection this week, Pisces. It's giving introspective energy—perfect time to journal, daydream, and let your intuition guide you. Trust the quiet nudges; they're usually right.
weekly.love: Venus is whispering sweet nothings, but the vibe is more about self-love rn. Whether single or coupled, focus on what makes you feel seen. Real connections happen when you're authentically yourself, no filters needed.
weekly.career: Your creative wavelength is hitting different this week. Ideas that felt fuzzy before are suddenly crystallizing. Don't second-guess yourself—pitch that project, speak up in meetings, your voice matters more than you think.
weekly.health: Your nervous system is calling for gentle vibes. Lean into things that ground you: long walks, creating something, time near water. Your body knows what it needs; listen to it without overthinking.
